Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, and his tenure ended after his April 1952 meeting with Stalin. He succeeded Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit, and K. P. S. Menon took over in 1952. Sources: [Wikipedia, List of ambassadors of India to Russia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ambassadors_of_India_to_Russia), [Wilson Center record of the 1952 Stalin meeting](https://digitalarchive.umd.edu/document/98608/download) (the Wilson Center item was cited in the search summary, but I did not open the link to confirm it).
